newsitem.title: USA: Several sports retailers in merger talks - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Several sports retailers in merger talks - NYT.

text.p: Sporting good retailers are in a talking mood with some of the top companies, including Sports Authority Inc, in the merger talks with others in the industry, the New York Times said.

In Thursday's edition, the Times said Sports Authority is in talks with Sportmart Inc, which in talks with Jumbosports. Meanwhile, Oshman's Sporting Goods Inc may also want in on any deals that may be cut, the Times said.
None of the companies would comment.
The companies may be interested in pursuing mergers in an industry that has grown in popularity -- and thus, number of retailers -- leading to price cuts and narrowing margins.
